change: Add Pack Tweaks / Always Diamond Sword with Self, All and OFF (default OFF).

behavior.Self: Local player held swords in first/third person, hotbar, own inventory slots and cursor/drag icons use the active resource pack diamond sword appearance. Other players, sword-holding entities, external container slots, dropped swords and item frames keep actual sword appearance.
behavior.All: All rendered swords use the active resource pack diamond sword appearance, including other players, mobs, inventory icons, dropped items and item frames.
behavior.gameplay: Only a temporary rendering copy is substituted. Real item type, count, damage, NBT, enchantments, tooltip, durability overlay, attributes, combat and networking remain unchanged.
behavior.resource_packs: Appearance is resolved through the current ItemModelMesher and OptiFine custom item model pipeline; no hardcoded texture or separate persistent model cache.

follow_up: Rename Off to OFF in the default, choices and help text; normalize legacy Off configuration values to OFF when loaded.
